game_title: Divide Or Floor – Vent Garden Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Mt. Pyre – Vent Garden, a garden growing near vents: the fire warden must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Divide Or Floor: Pick / or // to split fire gems evenly among allies without leaving fractions.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Vent Garden: a garden growing near vents
core_gameplay_loop: In Vent Garden, repeat each round: Pick / or // to split fire gems evenly among allies without leaving fractions. Each round, a new fire gems challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the share value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 420 points of fire gems by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 420, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 9 (extended tier): Divide Or Floor
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Divide Or Floor' (Week 2 slot 4), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Vent Garden'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how share changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Vent Garden.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 420 within 54 seconds.
